known_evil_iocs.description: Host filesystem access via container escape

attack_timeline.event: RCE exploit against vulnerable application in privileged container
Attacker leverages CAP_SYS_ADMIN to mount host filesystem
chroot /proc/1/root to escape to underlying host OS
SSH key installed on host for persistent access
Lateral movement to adjacent Kubernetes nodes
